short_name: Pediatric brain tumor radiotherapy registry metadata schema
description: Flat metadata schema for one patient-level radiotherapy registry record capturing pediatric demographics, tumor characteristics, treatment details, modifications, toxicities, interventions, and outcomes.

record_id.descr: Unique registry record identifier for one patient-treatment episode; use a stable alphanumeric code.

patient_pseudonym_id.descr: Pseudonymized patient identifier; must not contain directly identifying information.

course_id.descr: Identifier for the specific radiotherapy course if a patient has multiple treatment courses.

patient_age_years.descr: Age at the start of radiotherapy in years; use decimal values for months if needed (e.g., 3.5).

patient_weight_kg.descr: Body weight at baseline in kilograms (kg).

patient_height_cm.descr: Body height at baseline in centimeters (cm), if available.

sex_at_birth.descr: Sex assigned at birth; use controlled values such as male, female, intersex, or unknown.

race_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or chart-recorded race/ethnicity using the study's controlled vocabulary.

medical_history_summary.descr: Relevant prior medical history, including comorbidities and neurologic history; free-text summary or coded clinical summary.

prior_tumor_treatments.descr: Prior tumor-directed therapies before this radiotherapy course, such as surgery, chemotherapy, or prior irradiation.

primary_diagnosis.descr: Primary brain tumor diagnosis, preferably using a standardized term or ontology code.

tumor_histology.descr: Histologic subtype of the brain tumor, if known.

tumor_grade.descr: Pathologic or clinical tumor grade, if applicable (for example WHO grade).

tumor_location.descr: Anatomic location of the tumor in the brain or CNS, such as cerebellum, brainstem, or supratentorial region.

tumor_stage_or_extent.descr: Disease extent at treatment start, such as localized, metastatic, residual disease, or disseminated; use study-defined categories.

baseline_neurologic_status.descr: Neurologic status before radiotherapy, such as normal, focal deficit, seizure history, or other baseline impairment.

baseline_performance_status.descr: Functional status score before treatment, such as Lansky or Karnofsky score, with the scale specified in study documentation.

treatment_intent.descr: Intent of radiotherapy, such as curative, adjuvant, neoadjuvant, salvage, or palliative.

radiotherapy_modality.descr: Radiotherapy modality used, such as photon, proton, stereotactic, IMRT, VMAT, or whole-brain irradiation.

radiation_type.descr: Radiation type or beam category; use controlled values if modality and beam type are recorded separately.

target_volume_description.descr: Description of the irradiated target volume, such as tumor bed, focal lesion, craniospinal axis, or whole brain.

total_dose_gy.descr: Total prescribed radiation dose in Gray (Gy).

treatment_duration_days.descr: Total duration of the radiotherapy course in days from first to last fraction.

treatment_schedule.descr: Planned schedule, such as once daily, twice daily, or hypofractionated; use controlled terminology.

image_guidance_used.descr: Whether image guidance was used during treatment delivery.

anesthesia_required.descr: Whether anesthesia or sedation was required for radiotherapy delivery.

treatment_modifications_occurred.descr: Whether any treatment modifications occurred during the course of therapy.

treatment_modification_type.descr: Type of treatment modification, such as dose reduction, interruption, replanning, or field change.

treatment_modification_reason.descr: Reason for the treatment modification, such as toxicity, weight change, tumor response, machine issue, or patient intolerance.

treatment_modification_date.descr: Date when the first or most relevant treatment modification occurred.

treatment_compliance_percent.descr: Percentage of planned radiotherapy delivered/completed, if tracked.

acute_side_effects_summary.descr: Summary of acute treatment-related side effects observed during radiotherapy.

late_side_effects_summary.descr: Summary of late or delayed treatment-related side effects observed after radiotherapy, if available.

toxicity_grade_max.descr: Maximum observed toxicity grade using a standard scale such as CTCAE; record the highest grade observed.

neurologic_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any neurologic treatment-related toxicity occurred.

hematologic_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any hematologic treatment-related toxicity occurred.

gastrointestinal_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any gastrointestinal treatment-related toxicity occurred.

skin_toxicity_present.descr: Whether any skin or radiation dermatitis toxicity occurred.

treatment_related_interventions.descr: Interventions required because of side effects, such as medications, hospitalization, feeding support, steroids, transfusion, or treatment breaks.

intervention_required.descr: Whether any intervention was required to manage treatment-related side effects.

response_assessment_method.descr: Method used to assess response or tumor control, such as MRI, clinical exam, or tumor board review.

tumor_response_status.descr: Tumor response after treatment, such as complete response, partial response, stable disease, progression, or not assessed.

follow_up_duration_months.descr: Time from radiotherapy start or end to last follow-up in months, as defined by the study.

tumor_control_status.descr: Current tumor control status at last follow-up, such as controlled, recurrent, progressive, or unknown.

neurological_outcome_status.descr: Neurological outcome at follow-up, such as improved, unchanged, worsened, or not assessed.

survival_status.descr: Vital status at last follow-up, such as alive, dead, or lost to follow-up.

cause_of_death.descr: Cause of death if applicable, using clinical terminology.

last_follow_up_date.descr: Date of most recent clinical follow-up.
